_readme: S409 SkyOcotillo, 2026-10-17. Hartnell's Coursedog catalog page fetched, from its own scripts, a whole-catalog PDF the vendor generated on 2026-08-21 (pdf-reports call; includePrograms true, with requirement sets) on Coursedog's public bucket (run 39077713662). If it is the 2026-2027 catalog and prints each program's course list, the whole-catalog PDF reader can follow it through a procedure catalog step with no new reader. This read prints the pages naming the year and one program. Pages only, no model call, no table write.
